_: Argo Hall -> Peterson Hall, cut out of the measured campus by scripts/build-corridor.mjs. The world here is a CROP: every ring, height, tree and colour is copied verbatim from campus-3d/lidar/arcgis/colors.json and nothing is surveyed, moved or guessed. The `game` key is the exception and is invented — see game.invented.

game.invented: Obstacles, coins and lanes are placed by this builder, not surveyed. The campus they sit in is measured; these are not.

facades._: Facade colours MEASURED from 4K walk (Nov 2023, eye level) and drone (Nov 2022, overcast) footage, 2026-08-03 — see git history. walls = the dominant wall tone; accents = the secondary materials on the same building; styles = which facade tile it wears. Every key must name a mass the renderer actually builds (tests/campus-facades.test.mjs pins that) — the previous file spent eleven entries on names the data does not carry, and they drew nothing. WS-E4 (2026-08-06) populated the masses section from campus-eighth.json's Eighth College dossier: Sankofa Tower (m:-68,594, #cdc5c7) reuses the fins tile — its measured 2m vertical-bay/glazed-notch precast rhythm is a narrow-pier-over-recessed-glass read that fins already draws. Podemos (m:-56,528, #d4cbc9) reuses eggcrate — its punched-window-grid on precast is a deep two-axis grid, the same rhythm eggcrate was built for. Sankofa Mid (m:-116,613, #efe7e9) and Azad (m:-182,614, #d8d3d3) are ordinary punched-window stucco with no standout rhythm in the footage, so they keep the default band (no style key) rather than force a tile that oversells the read. Pulse Tower (m:-154,556) and Pulse Mid (m:-186,562), both #e2dade from the same source facade (r1c1-plan-00-south.png), share a new `paired` tile: their measured paired-bay rhythm (windows grouped in twos per structural bay) did not fit any of the eight existing tiles cleanly — band, ribbon and bands assume a continuous run, balcony and glass assume a void or curtain wall, fins and eggcrate assume a single-window grid — so one new tile was added rather than force a mismatch; it is the only new tile this workstream introduces. Sankofa Base (m:-97,609) stays out of masses entirely: the dossier resolved only a canopy accent, never a wall colour (occluded in every captured frame), and an unmeasured wall is better absent than guessed. Cross-check: all 6 masses' campus-arcgis.json massing.levels exactly equal the dossier's visually-counted storeys (21/16/10/9/10/9) with h/levels ≈ 3.05m for every one, so there is no GIS-vs-frame storey disagreement for Eighth. 2026-08-06, later: WS-E4 covered six masses but MISSED Survivance, whose two masses therefore fell through to the name key `Survivance` = #c9ad85, a tan that the Apple 3D capture flatly contradicts — it is the same white as its neighbours. Added m:-156,668 (main mass, 33.5 m / 11 levels) = #efebee, sampled from .cache/eighth-area/r4c2-oblique-00-south.png by splitting the facade rectangle at its own median luminance and taking the median of the light half, so windows and shadow do not drag the wall tone down. The sampler was calibrated on this file's own trusted answers before being believed: it returned #efebed for Sankofa Mid (recorded #efe7e9) and #d2cacc for Sankofa Tower (recorded #cdc5c7). Survivance's 6.1 m base (m:-142,666) stays out for the same reason Sankofa Base does — its dark bronze-grey reads clearly in the frames but was not measured, and an unmeasured wall is better absent than guessed. PROVENANCE CORRECTION 2026-08-06 (independent review, verified by recomputing every station-to-mass distance with the repo own toLocal): the sentence above names r4c2-oblique-00-south.png as the source frame for Survivance #efebee. That citation is NOT defensible. r4c2 is indeed the closest capture station to Survivance, but at 55.5 m, and the nearest mass to r4c2 is AZAD at 23 m with Sankofa Mid second at 43 m — Survivance is only third in its own source frame. Without a recorded camera pose for the Apple captures there is no way to project footprints into the frame and prove which facade the patch covered, so #efebee is a NEIGHBOURHOOD reading, not a per-building measurement. It is kept rather than reverted because the direction is not in doubt — Survivance stands plainly the same near-white as its neighbours in the Apple 3D capture, and the tan #c9ad85 it replaced was contradicted by every frame it appears in — but it must be treated as provisional and re-measured from a station-registered capture. The same caution applies to any hex in campus-eighth.json whose station-proximity justification was recomputed and found false.
